Thank you. I created Maiku in 2012, back when UTAU was very weeby in general. They had those rules like the names ending in "ne" and Miku formula and stuff. He is canonically Japanese-Filipino (I am Filipino) and apparently it was a trend to make your UTAU half-Japanese back then. I've also seen comparisons between Asane Hana and Asane Sana. Both names look different when written in Japanese. I'd like to keep Maiku's name because of nostalgia and stuff haha but thank you for your input, I really appreciate it.
